project.purpose: R2.1 source-qualified recursive responsibility boundaries for the existing Gateway MCP northbound contract. The preexisting Gateway Windows carrier R2 remains deployment-oriented and is NOT a second Gateway semantics authority.

nodes.label: NorthboundGatewayContract
nodes.responsibility: Expose a replaceable, non-authoritative MCP northbound interface for existing Runtime, Host and registered capability providers; adapt but never duplicate their semantic truth.
inputs: Authenticated MCP call and explicitly configured owner capability routes.
outputs: Stable MCP action and typed result/error, with source-qualified natural-owner references.
behavioralContract: The full Gateway is a composite transport/compatibility seam; its success does not imply physical execution or domain acceptance.
Routed owner errors, identity and observational uncertainty must not silently become successful capabilities.
acceptance: The official client configuration selects one Gateway MCP endpoint, while Runtime/Host retain effect and continuity authority.
Native Gateway tests verify bounded source behavior, not deployed client availability.

nodes.label: CapabilityRouteIdentity
nodes.responsibility: Map public capabilities to explicit natural-owner routes while preventing advertised/target identity substitution and implicit expansion of an empty configuration.
inputs: Configured CapabilityRoute map or None default catalog, source-owned research capability references.
outputs: Stable capability→owner selection, or rejection of inconsistent map entries.
behavioralContract: routes=None selects configured defaults; routes={} intentionally exposes no capabilities. A map key unequal to CapabilityRoute.capability is rejected before any dispatch.
Routing metadata never grants permission, proves owner availability or changes provider-owned execution contexts.

nodes.label: OwnerCapabilityObservation
nodes.responsibility: Project an on-demand, read-only qualified capability view by observing selected Runtime and Host owners; keep unavailability distinct from missing configuration and never cache owner truth across requests.
inputs: Qualified G01 route selection, configured owner endpoints, owner runtime.describe or host.status responses, bounded observation budget.
outputs: Deterministically ordered CapabilityProjection with configured/available flags or explicit observation_error.
behavioralContract: Only read-only observations may fan out with one bounded TaskGroup per request; a failing or timed-out owner remains unavailable/unknown for that observation, never a fabricated success.
Source-side configured status and actual owner availability are independent; observations are not cached across requests and never authorize effects.
acceptance: Native capability projection and concurrency tests cover incomplete owner evidence and deterministic ordering; source-only tests do not establish live owner health.

nodes.label: RuntimeOperationIdentityBridge
nodes.responsibility: Lower execution submit/resolve/get/cancel to the selected Runtime owner and preserve exact Job, request and operation reference identity, including terminal and artifact state uncertainty.
inputs: Admitted Runtime execution capability, caller request id / exact public operationRef, provider-defined execution context.
outputs: Owner-correlated ExecutionReceipt, Resolution or Observation without new Job/Attempt facts.
behavioralContract: execution.cancel and get route by the exact Runtime owner/native Job from operationRef; reject mismatched returned Job IDs and nonboolean terminality before exposing a receipt.
A successful Gateway command is not proof that process termination, side effects or domain outcome has occurred; owner-reported recovery errors remain typed.
acceptance: Native Gateway execution tests reject mismatched cancellation Job, untyped terminality and unqualified workspace; no physical execution correctness claim.

nodes.label: RuntimeArtifactReadReference
nodes.responsibility: Route artifact.read to the exact Runtime operation owner while preserving artifact identity and rejecting invented or owner-mismatched artifact evidence.
inputs: Qualified Runtime operationRef and artifactId, existing Runtime artifact.read provider response.
behavioralContract: Artifact bytes must be read through the Runtime owner specified by the operation reference; absence of artifact source identity cannot be filled with fabricated IDs.
Read results do not imply domain validation or release currentness; external.pull artifact semantics are distinct from Runtime artifacts.
acceptance: Native artifact owner binding and incomplete artifact projection checks pass; no live artifact durability inference.

nodes.label: HostContinuityAndCollaborationAdapter
nodes.responsibility: Expose stable Host Work/Social/Attention operations as thin northbound read/write routing without recreating Host state or reinterpretation of WorkingCheckpoint schema.
inputs: Explicit Host continuation/social tool request and opaque owner-managed checkpoint/message or pagination arguments.
outputs: Host-owned Work/Social/Attention values, mutation receipts or qualified errors.
behavioralContract: Host remains sole semantic state owner; Gateway forwards bounded Host arguments and preserves returned identity, cursor and native error semantics.
Host unavailability is not permission to mint a replacement Host ledger, cursor or workflow state in Gateway.
acceptance: Native Host-northbound compatibility tests verify exact delegated semantics in a fake-owner lane.

nodes.label: ServerBoundArtifactAuthorizationTarget
nodes.responsibility: Derive an exact protected Runtime-artifact authorization resource from trusted Gateway operation reference semantics before invoking the existing Security authorizer; reject unknown targets closed.
inputs: Verified ingress request state; artifact.read tool name; exact Runtime operationRef/artifactId; trusted Security policy interface.
outputs: Qualified CapabilityAuthorizationTarget and Security authorization result or fail-closed error before owner call.
behavioralContract: Untrusted tool arguments or MCP metadata cannot supply principal authority. A malformed/foreign artifact owner or mismatched Security principal/resource cannot reach a protected owner call.
Optional narrow PEP does not claim all Gateway methods are authorized; absent Security provider or a denied protected request must not silently allow that protected effect.
acceptance: Native Security PEP tests cover server-derived resource identity, malformed/foreign references, principal mismatch, denial and unavailable authorizer.
mustNotOwn: authorization of every method by assumption

consumerBindings.operation: build_server installs GatewayCapabilityAuthorizationMiddleware only when a trusted CapabilityAuthorizer is injected for protected Tool requests

nodes.label: IngressPrincipalVerification
nodes.responsibility: Verify the declared northbound Cloudflare Access or loopback service identity and inject bounded authenticated request identity for subsequent optional authorization/routing.
inputs: Incoming Gateway request headers, configured verifier issuer/audience/key material or local loopback token file.
outputs: Verified request principal context or rejection; no raw token disclosure.
behavioralContract: Unverified assertions, wrong issuer/audience/expiry/subject and invalid loopback bearer must not become authenticated principal.
Authenticated ingress is distinct from object-level authorization and does not transfer owner execution privileges.
acceptance: Native ingress tests reject bad claims, enforce loopback-only service bearer and preserve separate remote Cloudflare verification.

consumerBindings.operation: GatewayCapabilityAuthorizationMiddleware consumes ingress-verified request state principal and issuer; malformed/absent identity fails before Security/owner forwarding

nodes.label: ExactResearchSkillRecipeResolution
nodes.responsibility: Resolve a named source-owned research capability into an exact scoped Skill/Tool invocation recipe; unlike G01 route identity and G02 availability this returns binding, not execution.
nodes.authority: Gateway delegated interface/optional local worker; natural downstream owner retains facts
inputs: Current research recipe and optional qualified Skills Owner view
outputs: CapabilityResolution with exact Skill ID and resource binding or typed UNKNOWN/error; no invoked Skill effect
behavioralContract: Unsupported ordinary execution capabilities do not falsely acquire a composition resolver.
Absent/unconfigured Skills Owner remains observation UNKNOWN; a resolved recipe does not run it or grant a Tool capability.
mustNotOwn: Universal Agent approval or execution authority
replacementConditions: Preserve exact Skill identity, caller scope, unknown standing and non-executing resolution even if recipe provider changes.
formalObligations: Bind concrete Skill source digest, caller visibility, effective installed gateway/skill versions before asserting active ability.
Abstract discovery/resolution does not imply actual Tool/Harness realization.

nodes.label: OptionalExternalPullLeaseAndReplay
nodes.responsibility: If the optional external.pull worker is configured, own the local operation/request replay and bounded worker lease/generation/attempt transitions separately from Runtime native Job truth.
nodes.authority: Gateway delegated interface/optional local worker; natural downstream owner retains facts
inputs: Exact capability/requestId and parcel; qualified Worker enrollment and generation
outputs: ExternalOperation/attempt/lease/artifact receipt or explicit typed conflict/UNKNOWN
behavioralContract: Same request with altered parcel fails, expired/revoked generation cannot commit, and a started/ambiguous effect is not auto-dispatched again.
The current SQLite local ledger is optional historical state, not evidence of installed Postgres cutover or actual external provider success.
mustNotOwn: Universal Agent approval or execution authority
replacementConditions: Retirement/reuse review first: if no real configured consumer then remove the optional legacy carrier; if needed prefer external mature Worker provider or PG and prove migration/lease/replay equivalence.
formalObligations: Persistent legacy SQLite -> PG cutover equivalence and model-to-installed physical effect proof UNKNOWN.

gaps: All G00..G07 identities are source-side qualified only. Static plugin MCP configuration is a declared external consumer path; it does not establish live connected client invocation or loaded deployment currentness.

Gateway Windows R2 is a separate historical deployment carrier. Its GW* task-planning labels, sourceVersion and historical installed observations are not general Gateway LEGO identity or CURRENTNESS authority.
External.pull worker is optional transport with separate authority and SQLite historical mechanics; do not infer a universal Gateway job store, production authorizer, or mandatory lifecycle.
Cross-owner dynamic callers and qualified runtime effects remain UNKNOWN until exact installed Gateway, Runtime, Host, Security, external principal and source-cut receipts are bound.

Proof obligations: G06 cannot access G04 without trusted G07 principal and exact resource, G03 cannot substitute Runtime Job identity, G02 observation never grants G03 execution; abstract positive examples are not an implementation-wide proof.
G08 Skills resolution uses a source-side recipe and optional natural Skills owner: current verified binding/version and dynamic Agent consumers UNKNOWN.

G09 bounded native pull attempt is an optional legacy SQLite writer: before any keep/delete/PG cutover, verify actual installed workers and no lost unique records; SOURCE and installed truth are separate.
